unit: nlm-trajectory (Task B diagnostic: global adapters after the first and second aggregation of the first two federated sessions)
what: No training. The global adapters after aggregation 1 and aggregation 2 (objects _2_aggregation_ and _3_aggregation_ in the transfer bucket, client A copy) of ran-nlm-fed-20261102T0911 (run1_agg1, run1_agg2) and ran-nlm-fed-rep2-20261102T1149 (rep2_agg1, rep2_agg2) are scored on the frozen test text with the same grader, writing one record per test example. Purpose: to see directly whether the global adapter swings between families from round to round, which the in-client validation logs suggested but could not show.

target.metric: none: a diagnostic, nothing is pass or fail
target.direction: Hypothesis written before the run (not tested until now): after aggregation 1 the adapter mostly answers NONE; later aggregations favour one family and the favoured family differs between sessions. A result that does not look like this is reported as it is.

model_id: OTel-LLM-1.7B-IT (organisers' bucket) + LoRA r=8 alpha=16 on q,k,v,o,gate,up,down; ran-fl/taskb/model-code/model.py
grader: ran-fl/taskb/taskb_job.py (deterministic: log-likelihood ranking of the candidate FAMILY, CAUSE and ACTION; no model-written labels, no LLM judge)
